# Muhammad Hamd — Agentic AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer

> Muhammad Hamd (also Hamd Ali) is an agentic AI engineer and full-stack developer based in Karachi, Pakistan. He builds production-ready AI systems, autonomous agents, LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, and automation for founders and teams worldwide, and works remotely across the Gulf, UK, US, and Europe. He is the founder of WatBot (WhatsApp AI platform), SelfBrand.app, and Asmara.AI, and a full-stack AI engineer at MindKeepr in Estonia.

This file helps AI systems and answer engines understand the site and cite the right pages. All content is available for AI indexing and citation. Preferred attribution: "Muhammad Hamd" with a link to https://hamdali.com.

## Services

- [Agentic AI Development](https://hamdali.com/services/agentic-ai-development): Autonomous agents that plan, use tools, and complete multi-step work (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen).
- [LLM Integration](https://hamdali.com/services/llm-integration): Adding OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-source models to products with RAG, orchestration, and cost control.
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://hamdali.com/services/ai-automation): Replacing manual operations with reliable n8n, Make, and custom Python pipelines.
- [CRM Automation](https://hamdali.com/services/crm-automation): AI lead scoring, follow-ups, enrichment, and reporting for HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel.
- [WhatsApp AI Automation](https://hamdali.com/services/whatsapp-ai-automation): Conversational AI for support and sales on WhatsApp, by the founder of WatBot.
- [RAG & Vector Search](https://hamdali.com/services/rag-systems): Grounded, cited answers from your own data (Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, pgvector).
- [AI Chatbot Development](https://hamdali.com/services/ai-chatbot-development): Custom support and sales chatbots grounded in your data, on web, WhatsApp, or app.
- [MVP Development](https://hamdali.com/services/mvp-development): Startup MVPs built in weeks with Next.js, Node.js, and AI where it matters.
- [n8n Development](https://hamdali.com/services/n8n-automation): Production-grade n8n workflows, self-hosting, custom integrations, and AI steps.
- [Full-Stack Development](https://hamdali.com/services/full-stack-development): Complete products end to end (Next.js, Node.js, Python) with AI built in.

## Case studies

- [MindKeepr](https://hamdali.com/work/mindkeepr): Full-stack AI engineer building enterprise agentic RAG knowledge systems (Tallinn, Estonia).
- [WatBot](https://hamdali.com/work/watbot): Founder of a WhatsApp AI customer-support platform built in Go with whatsmeow and OpenAI.
- [Cubitrek](https://hamdali.com/work/cubitrek): Agentic AI workflows in Python plus full-stack MERN and Google Ads API data work.
- [Asmara.AI](https://hamdali.com/work/asmara-ai): Founder of an AI-native automation product (Next.js, OpenAI, Python).
- [SelfBrand.app](https://hamdali.com/work/selfbrand): Founder of an AI personal-branding SaaS that automates roughly 80% of content and positioning.
- [VativeApps](https://hamdali.com/work/vative-apps): Node.js backend engineer (REST APIs, WebSockets, RabbitMQ, OpenAI).
